answer: The raven counter is kept in horizon and crystal publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 103 aliases cost 172 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
